name: Pasta Frittata with Spinach, Mushrooms, Basil & Parmesan

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice mushrooms and place in a large bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onions. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the mushrooms.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the mushrooms, onion, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 7-8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Finely grate Parmesan. Place half in the reserved bowl along with eggs, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine and set aside. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
170 g Parmesan cheese
15 eggs
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the mushrooms and onions are tender, add basil and spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add cooked pasta to the skillet. Drizzle with additional oil, toss to combine with the veggies, then smooth out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Pour the egg mixture over the pasta. As the eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 8-10 minutes.
Sprinkle reserved Parmesan over the pasta frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set and golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Remove from the oven and slice into wedges.
To serve, divide pasta frittata between plates and enjoy!
